title: Record the mapping decisions and the owner's open questions
description:
## Intent

Settle the mapping decisions the specs will encode, and list what the owner must decide.

## Decisions to record in `design/daw-set.md`

- Warp mode per Apricity mode (`complex`, `beats`, `texture`, `repitch`), given that the DAW's algorithms are not Rubber Band: which mode sounds closest.
- Notes that overlap on one track (pitched chords, `at` notes, humanize): split into as few extra tracks as needed inside a group track named after the track (the proposal), or something else.
- Reverse: the DAW's own reverse flag (if the set can express it without a pre-rendered file) or Apricity writes a reversed copy of the region into the project.
- Tuning correction plus transposition: how semitones and cents combine within the DAW's detune range.
- Where level beyond the DAW's clip gain or fader range goes (a Utility device).
- Loudness target: measure make-up gain with the engine at export time, or leave it to the user.
- Locators: one per chord change (proposal) or one per bar.
- Effects with no stock match (e.g. `lofi wow`, reverb types) and how they're reported.
- Target DAW version(s).

## Verification

Each item above has a dated "Decisions" or "Open questions" entry in `design/daw-set.md`; open questions are copied as a comment on the initiative apricitus-6edba8.

## Release

Rides on the design-note commit (`docs(...)`).
